name: print-social-tarot-free-daily-insight-flyer-fanned-cards-dotted-rays
title: 'Free Daily Insight' tarot flyer with fanned illustrated tarot cards and dotted rays from a sparkle
whatItIs: A square flyer with a sparkle star logo 'tarot.com', a bold black 'FREE Daily Insight' headline, dotted rays radiating from small sparkle and diamond icons toward a fan of illustrated tarot cards (numbered 18, 21, 22) showing sun and figure motifs, blue and purple circle accents, and an orange footer with a phone number.
whatItMeans: Mystical yet approachable; dotted rays connecting icons to the cards suggest insight radiating outward toward the reader.
techniques: Fan illustrated cards to suggest a real tarot spread.
Connect small icons to the main visual with dotted rays.
Use simple sparkle and diamond shapes as mystical accents.

vocabulary.definition: Cards spread in an overlapping arc.
A broken line suggesting light or energy radiating outward.
